main_text.l: pam per quam Papa in dorfum iftius
fiafticæ seu Spiritualis, per quam Papa
cæ, quam ab ejus divitiis, robore &
Sed, quod Tu, vir Magne, judicii
acerrimi & fubacti non credis, aut non
admittis hafce utilitates, in caufa eft
vis oculis legeris, fed Te adduci, aut

page.notes: The first line of the page is the running head; the printed page number is "51". Greek word in paragraph 2 transcribed as printed and may be imperfect ("προσκσίαν" as printed, likely προσαγωγίαν/προσαγωγήν). The heading-like numbers "2." and "4." are paragraph numbers, kept as paragraphs. Some letters in the scan are blurred; no further doubtful words marked.
